comparison_metric: COCO-style APs, small < 32^2 on original validation GT, maxDets=500
protocol_note: AP/AP50/AP75/AR500 are from the official VisDrone DET algorithm Python port; APs/APm/APl are supplementary.

pairing_notes.fixed_vs_adaptive: strictly paired for seed 20260824; both used optimizer=auto resolving to MuSGD(lr=0.01, momentum=0.9) and warmup_bias_lr=0.0
pairing_notes.tal: not a strict three-way pair: explicit MuSGD matched lr/momentum/weight decay but retained warmup_bias_lr=0.1; rerun with warmup_bias_lr=0.0 or exclude from strict three-way aggregation

acceptance.rule: mean adaptive-fixed APs >= 1.0 pp across 3 paired seeds and at least 2/3 positive
acceptance.reason: Only seed 20260824 is complete; seeds 20260825 and 20260826 remain.
